label.purpose: Short section provenance and status labels.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Color feedback on interactive state changes only.

components.name: Approve idea
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 24px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-surface); font: 750 16px/1.5 system-ui; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Reject
components.description: A clear secondary decision without false visual equivalence.
components.css: .ds-btn-reject { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-danger); font: 750 16px/1.5 system-ui; } .ds-btn-reject:hover { background: var(--color-uncertain-soft); } .ds-btn-reject:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Review navigation
components.description: Familiar navigation with a written active location.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 220px; padding: 16px; background: var(--color-canvas); } .ds-nav a { min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--color-ink-muted); text-decoration: none; font: 650 14px/1.5 system-ui; } .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { background: var(--color-verified-soft); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Evidence marker
components.description: A compact source and time entry in the household evidence ledger.
components.css: .ds-evidence { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 16px 1fr; gap: 12px; color: var(--color-ink); font: 400 16px/1.5 system-ui; } .ds-evidence > span { width: 15px; height: 15px; margin-top: 4px; border: 3px solid var(--color-surface); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-verified); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--color-verified); } .ds-evidence strong, .ds-evidence small { display: block; } .ds-evidence small { color: var(--color-ink-muted); font-size: 14px; }

components.name: Household field
components.description: A visible label and resizable note field.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--color-ink); font: 650 16px/1.5 system-ui; } .ds-field textarea { min-height: 96px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-ink); font: 400 16px/1.5 system-ui; resize: vertical; } .ds-field textarea:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: A quiet place to examine one consequential idea. Familiar navigation provides orientation while a continuous review sheet separates Agent-authored claims, Hub evidence, and household judgment.

rules.name: The Rare Blue Rule
rules.body: Primary blue appears only for active location, focus, links, and the main approval action.

rules.name: The Continuous Sheet Rule
rules.body: A review is one document, never a stack of nested cards.

dos: Retain the evidence ledger as the signature review pattern.
donts: Do not build a wall of device toggles.
Do not expose secrets or raw Agent internals in the primary workflow.
